items.q: What can I do with one minute of audio?
items.a: It builds a voice profile. From then on, type any sentence and it's read aloud in that voice — across as many alarms as you like. You can also use a raw recording as-is, or optionally auto-generate a fresh line daily from contexts like weather or fortune.

items.q: Where does my voice go after I record it?
items.a: Nothing leaves the group. Family, partner, and friend groups are invite-code only. Recipients can play voices in their own library, but cannot export or download them.

items.q: Are there forced missions, like math or photo challenges?
items.a: No. AlarmTalk is built around emotional waking, not forced waking. The goal is to wake up to a voice you genuinely want to hear.

Two groups. Fans who want to wake up to their favorite idol, voice actor, or character — and seniors and long-distance families who want their child, grandchild, or partner's voice every morning. Both share one thing: a specific voice they want to hear daily.

Basic voice alarms with a single voice profile are free. Family/partner sharing, multiple voice profiles, auto-generated contexts (weather, fortune, etc.), and the character system are part of paid plans.
Android native first. iOS follows once we've validated AlarmKit separately.

principles.headline: Five principles we work by
principles.description: We are early — going from zero to one. That's exactly why clear principles matter more, not less.

items.title: Build something people want every day
items.body: Not a one-time trick. The first thing people meet every morning.

items.title: Treat trust as the heaviest constraint
items.body: Voice cloning shares roots with voice phishing. Closed sharing and no-export are non-negotiable.

items.title: Emotion over force
items.body: Not a louder alarm — one you actually want to hear. We wake the mind, not just the body.

items.title: Ask for a 10× answer
items.body: We don't chase 10% gains. We look for an answer that is 10× different — a third path beyond beeps and missions.

items.title: Build globally from day one
items.body: Not a Korea-only product. We assume a multilingual, multicultural user from the first commit.
